EX-99.1 2 qs-ex99_1.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 1 Dear shareholders, We’re excited to provide an update on our progress over the past quarter. Eagle Line Update We inaugurated the Eagle Line pilot cell production line in February of this year, and it has already become the workhorse of our customer engagement, allowing an increased pace of customer sampling which is flowing into customer billings. Our progress on demonstrating scalable production has given us the confidence to take the next steps for production scale-up beyond the designed capacity of the Eagle Line. Today we announced a QS ecosystem partnership with Muehlbauer Group to provide cell assembly equipment for a planned 100 megawatt-hour (MWh) cell production line. This 100-MWh line will represent the first commercial-scale mass production of QS cells, with output aimed at meeting the rapidly emerging opportunities for our QSDC and QSAS business verticals. Engineering work on higher-throughput processes and equipment is already underway and start of production for this new line is targeted for 2028. Muehlbauer Group is a highly respected German provider of manufacturing and automation equipment. Working on site in San Jose, their engineers evaluated the Eagle Line pilot processes for scalability and readiness and developed design enhancements to bring the technology to mass production, beginning with this 100-MWh line and working toward gigawatt-hour scale.
